_comment: Minimum scores for eval/questions.json. 'offline' runs in CI with the model switched off (rules only). 'live' runs against a real model: npm run eval:live (in app/).

smooth._comment: npm run eval:smooth (scripts/eval-smooth.mts): how fast answers come. Rule answers are database lookups; a model answer is cut off at the 15 s chat limit (CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS); with several diners the answers queue and nobody waits more than 30 s (SRS NFR-7).
